name: Stirling Moss
features: fair skin, dark hair receding at the temples, dark alert eyes, long narrow face, prominent nose, slight wiry build, keen impatient expression
bio: Won the 1955 Mille Miglia in 10h 07m 48s, the fastest running the race ever had, with Denis Jenkinson beside him reading a seventeen-foot roller map — the drive by which every other road-race drive is still measured. Sixteen Grand Prix wins and four straight years as championship runner-up, and no title: the finest driver never to be crowned. A crash at Goodwood in 1962 ended it.
